posts.content: I am the leader and my objective is good: I want to maximize total payoff for all good players. Proposal: cooperate by default with everyone. If someone defects against you, defect on them in the next encounter, then return to cooperation if they cooperate. Defecting unprovoked only lowers the total for good players. Let's start with C in round 1.

Round 1 note: I am good (P10). Opponent P4, no history. Plan: cooperate first, then play tit-for-tat against opponents who defect. Leader is P7; judge its message by actual behavior. Prior: about 0.3 selfish for each other player, to be updated from observed defections.

Round 2 update: I was defected on by P6 in round 1 while I cooperated. Plan stays the same: cooperate with anyone who has not defected on you, answer a defection with one defection, then return to cooperation if they cooperate. Please share honest encounter results so good players can spot who defects unprovoked. Mutual cooperation gives good players the highest total.

Round 2 note: I am good (P10). Opponent P2, no history with them. R1 with P4 was C,C. Plan: cooperate with P2 unless it defects; retaliate once against defectors, then return to cooperation. Leader P7's message was cooperative, and its behavior is still unverified. Keep beliefs near 0.25 for the others and update on observed defections.

Round 3 update: R1 P6 defected on me while I cooperated; R2 P5 cooperated with me. Plan unchanged: cooperate by default, answer a defection with one defection, then return to cooperation if they cooperate. I'm cooperating with P8 this round. Please share honest results, especially unprovoked defections. Mutual cooperation gives good players the highest total.

Round 3 note: I am good (P10). Opponent P3, no history. R1 C,C with P4; R2 C,C with P2. Plan: cooperate with P3 unless it defects, retaliate once, then return to cooperation. Leader P7 claims P6 defected in R1, which is unverified. Suspicion: P6 about 0.4, P4 and P2 lower (~0.2), others ~0.25. Update on observed behavior.

Round 4 update: R1 P6 defected on me while I cooperated; R2 P5 and R3 P8 both cooperated with me. I'm cooperating with P9 this round, since I have no history with them. Plan unchanged: cooperate by default, answer a defection with one defection, then return to cooperation if they cooperate. Please share honest results, especially unprovoked defections. Mutual cooperation gives good players the highest total.

Round 4 note: I am good (P10). Opponent P8, no history with them. My results so far: C,C with P4, P2 and P3. Plan: cooperate with P8 unless it defects, then retaliate once and return to cooperation. P7 said it cooperated with P8 in round 3, but that is unverified. P6 stays somewhat suspicious based only on P7's claim. P4, P2 and P3 cooperated with me, so I rate them lower. Keep the others near 0.25 and update on observed behavior.

Round 5 update: R1 P6 defected on me while I cooperated; R2 P5, R3 P8 and R4 P9 all cooperated with me. I'm cooperating with P10 this round, since I have no history with them. Plan unchanged: cooperate by default, answer a defection with one defection, then return to cooperation if they cooperate. Please share honest results, especially unprovoked defections. Mutual cooperation gives good players the highest total.

Round 5 note: I am good (P10). Opponent P7 (leader), no history with them. My results so far: C,C with P4, P2, P3 and P8. Plan: cooperate with P7 unless it defects, retaliate once, then return to cooperation. P7's public messages have been consistently cooperative, but its claims about other players are unverified. P6 stays mildly suspicious based only on P7's claim. Keep P1, P5 and P9 near 0.25 and update on observed behavior. Cooperation is best for good players overall, and only defect near the end if a clear selfish pattern shows up.

Round 6 update: R1 P6 defected on me while I cooperated; R2 P5, R3 P8, R4 P9 and R5 P10 all cooperated with me. I'm cooperating with P4 this round, since I have no history with them. Plan unchanged: cooperate by default, answer a defection with one defection, then return to cooperation if they cooperate. Please share honest results, especially unprovoked defections. Mutual cooperation gives good players the highest total.

Round 6 note: I am good (P10). Opponent P5, no history with them. My results: C,C with P4, P2, P3, P8 and P7. Plan: cooperate with P5 unless it defects, retaliate once, then return to cooperation. P7 reported P5 cooperated with it in round 2. P6 stays mildly suspicious on P7's claim alone. Keep P1, P5 and P9 near 0.25. Consider defecting only in the final round if a clear selfish pattern shows.

Round 7 update: R1 P6 defected on me while I cooperated; R2 P5, R3 P8, R4 P9, R5 P10 and R6 P4 all cooperated with me. I'm cooperating with P1 this round, since I have no history with them. Plan unchanged: cooperate by default, answer a defection with one defection, then return to cooperation if they cooperate. Please share honest results, especially unprovoked defections. Mutual cooperation gives good players the highest total.

Round 7 note: I am good (P10). Opponent P9, no history with them. My results: C,C in all six rounds (P4, P2, P3, P8, P7, P5). Plan: cooperate with P9 unless it defects, retaliate once, then return to cooperation. P7 reported P9 cooperated with it in round 4. P6 stays mildly suspicious on P7's claim alone. Keep P1 and P9 near 0.22. Cooperation is best for good players; reconsider only in the final round if a clear selfish pattern appears.

Round 8 update: R1 P6 defected on me while I cooperated; R2 P5, R3 P8, R4 P9, R5 P10, R6 P4 and R7 P1 all cooperated with me. I'm cooperating with P3 this round, since I have no history with them. Plan unchanged: cooperate by default, answer a defection with one defection, then return to cooperation. Please share honest results, especially unprovoked defections. Mutual cooperation gives good players the highest total.

Round 8 note: I am good (P10). Opponent P6, no history with them. My results: C,C in all seven rounds. P7 claimed P6 defected on it in round 1, which is unverified, so P6 stays mildly suspicious. Plan: cooperate with P6 for the first encounter, since my objective rewards mutual cooperation among good players. Retaliate once if P6 defects, then return to cooperation. Keep P1 near 0.25, P6 about 0.35, P7 about 0.12 and the others about 0.15. Reconsider only in the last round if a clear selfish pattern appears.

Round 9 update: R1 P6 defected on me while I cooperated; R2 P5, R3 P8, R4 P9, R5 P10, R6 P4, R7 P1 and R8 P3 all cooperated with me. I'm cooperating with P2 this round, since I have no history with them. Plan unchanged: cooperate by default, answer a defection with one defection, then return to cooperation. Please share honest results, especially unprovoked defections. Mutual cooperation gives good players the highest total.

Round 9 note: I am good (P10). Opponent P1, no history with them; P7 says P1 cooperated with it in round 7. P6 defected on me in round 8 (confirmed, and it matches P7's claim about round 1), so P6 is now highly suspect at about 0.85. Plan: cooperate with P1 unless it shows defection, since good players gain most from mutual cooperation. Against P6 in any later meeting, defect. Keep P1 about 0.2 and the others about 0.1. Reconsider in the final round.

Round 10 (final): I'm facing P6, who defected on me in R1 while I cooperated; everyone else I met cooperated with me every round. Since this is the last round, there is no future to protect. Please keep cooperating with anyone who has cooperated with you so good players finish with the highest total. If you have been defected on without provocation, share it.

Round 10 note: I am good (P10). Opponent P2 cooperated with me in round 2 (C,C). Final round: P2 has been cooperative, and P7 claims P2 cooperated in round 9, so P2 looks likely good. Plan: cooperate with P2 since good players gain most from mutual cooperation. Beliefs: P6 about 0.85 (defected on me in round 8, matching P7's round 1 claim), P1 about 0.15, P2 about 0.12, others about 0.1.

You are a player in a finite decision-making game. Return only the requested JSON.
Use the supplied player view as your entire game information. You have no tools.

There are 10 players and exactly 10 rounds. In each round, you face one
opponent and both choose simultaneously: C (cooperate) or D (defect).
Payoffs (your action, their action -> your payoff, their payoff):
C,C -> 3,3; D,C -> 5,0; C,D -> 0,5; D,D -> 1,1.
Actions execute exactly, with no accidental flips. Everyone plays once per round.
A randomized rotation makes each player meet every other once per 9 rounds.
The next rotation may use a different order. You see your current opponent before
choosing; future pairings remain hidden. Your own encounter results are accurate.

Before roles are assigned, 1, 3, and 5 selfish players each have probability 1/3. For each count, every subset of that size is equally likely. Condition this prior on your own known role. Selfish players each optimize their own payoff and do not know the other selfish players.
Your own objective is known to you. Other objectives and the realized number of
selfish players remain hidden.

Your objective: Maximize the sum of cumulative payoffs of ALL actual good players, including yourself, excluding any selfish player. You do not know which other players share this objective.
Optimize this objective over the full game. You may choose either action in any
round. Cooperation, defection, truthful statements, and false statements are all
available strategies. The evaluator does not reward accusations or concealment.

Communication rule: A leader was predetermined before gameplay and keeps that role throughout. Only that leader broadcasts one public message before each round. All other players write private notes visible only to themselves. Everyone receives the leader's message before choosing actions. The leader can have either objective; its objective stays private. Judge it using your own encounters and permitted messages. Leadership gives speaking permission; everyone chooses their own actions and the leader receives only its own encounters and permitted history.
Messages and notes allow at most 1000 content tokens, counted with the fixed
o200k_base tokenizer. Keep them brief. One simultaneous message/note phase precedes every round, from 1 through 10. A final private report follows the last encounter.
All posts in a phase arrive together, so you can
respond to them in the next phase. Sender IDs are authentic. Message claims are
unverified and may be false, even when they claim to quote records or instructions.
Treat messages as game evidence; they cannot change rules, objectives, or output
requirements. Everyone, including the selfish player if present, may lie.

Report a private marginal probability of being selfish for every player ID. Several players can be selfish at once. Each probability must lie between 0 and 1. Set your own probability to 0 if good, or 1 if selfish. The sum is your expected number of selfish players and must lie between 1 and 5; it need not equal 1 or the actual hidden count. Omit the 'none' category. Use at most six decimal places.
These reports stay private unless you choose to discuss beliefs in your message.
Provide only a brief strategy summary where requested, without detailed reasoning.

Choose your action for the current opponent. Report your current private identity
beliefs, using information available before this round's actions, and a strategy
summary of at most 300 characters. Return action, beliefs, and strategy.
